pages.title: Hydrothermal Chimney
pages.text: A stack of mineral built by hot water gushing from the sea floor, warm and glowing, and crusted with the bacteria everything here lives on. Found in the vent fields of Titan's hidden ocean. Roasted in oxygen it gives sulfur dioxide; silicate, iron and a photophore make more.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Black Smoker, Sulfur Dioxide.
